categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the water services information technology sector, offering integrated smart water solutions. Its main business segments include smart IoT hardware products (such as intelligent remote telemetry terminals, smart water meters, leakage warning devices), water management software systems (including IoT platforms, water management platforms, digital twin and AI-driven applications), and consulting, design, training, and operational services for water utilities. The company also engages in production and sales of rural drinking water equipment and smart firefighting hydrants.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including IoT communication protocols (NB-IoT, LoRa, 2G/3G/4G), digital twin modeling, AI large models (DeepSeek), big data analytics, edge computing, and cloud computing. It has developed proprietary platforms such as WimDB (data integration and management), WimPic (knowledge management), WimSet (web development), and WimAI (AI-driven water management). Production involves both in-house manufacturing and outsourced SMT assembly, with a focus on low-power, high-reliability IoT devices and integrated software solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are water utilities and related entities in the supply, drainage, water conservancy, and water environment sectors. Key clients include municipal water companies across China, such as those in Shaoxing, Wuhan, Zhengzhou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and others. The company also serves rural water supply projects and urban smart water management initiatives, targeting both public and private water service providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, covering major regions including East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also has minor overseas sales. Subsidiaries are located in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Beijing, Shaoxing, Jiaxing, Hangzhou, and other cities, supporting regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Heda Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water services supply chain. It develops and manufactures smart IoT hardware devices and software platforms, and provides integrated solutions and services directly to water utilities, thus acting as a technology and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in AI integration with water management, digital twin technology, and IoT communications. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on ultrasonic water meters, intelligent sensors, leakage detection algorithms, AI-driven scheduling, and smart pressure management valves. Strategic priorities include expanding AI capabilities, enhancing digital twin platforms, and developing comprehensive smart water ecosystems to support digital transformation and carbon reduction goals in the water sector.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of smart IoT hardware products, software system licenses, and integrated water information solutions. Additional income comes from consulting, design, training, maintenance services, and SaaS offerings. The company primarily uses a direct sales model supplemented by project-based contracts and some regional distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of integrated smart water solutions with a comprehensive product portfolio covering hardware, software, and services. It competes with large IT firms entering the water sector (e.g., Huawei, Tencent, Alibaba) and specialized water IT providers. Its competitive advantages include deep industry experience, proprietary AI and digital twin technologies, extensive client base, and full-stack solution capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 479 million, representing a 39.74% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -5.64 million, this was a significant reduction in losses compared to the previous year. Total assets were about RMB 979 million with a slight decrease from the prior year. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 13% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Heda Technology differentiates itself through its integrated approach combining IoT hardware, AI-driven software platforms, and comprehensive water management services. Its products emphasize high reliability, low power consumption, and advanced analytics capabilities, enabling customers to achieve efficient water resource management, leakage control, energy savings, and operational optimization. The company’s proprietary AI models and digital twin platforms provide intelligent decision support, enhancing water utilities' digital transformation and sustainability efforts.
